Can you play Freak Drive when you are on your way to torpor,
to untap after a Daring the Dawn action or a Day Operation?

Freak Drive - Action Modifier (for) (1)
Is played at the end of an action, but still during the action.
It cannot be played on an action that was made unpreventable by
Concoction of Vitality, for example. [LSJ 981028]

Carpe Noctem.

TheLa...@hotmail.com wrote:
> Can you play Freak Drive when you are on your way to torpor,
> to untap after a Daring the Dawn action or a Day Operation?

Yes.

You can also play Freak Drive in torpor (after a Regeneration
or even a blocked Movement of the Slow Body, for example).
